label: crawler
task: Breadth-first GET of every known URL once, including probe paths that don't exist (/llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /openapi.json, /sitemap.xml, /robots.txt, *.md).
mechanism: scripts/capture.ts proxy + a client sending UA 'AcmeDocsBot/1.0 (+https://acme.example/bot)'. No JavaScript, no assets.
notes: Enumerates everything (12 URLs/run); 0% asset ratio; a bot UA. Produces dead-end (404) and demand-signal traffic. Reproduce with `scripts/capture-session.sh <out> ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/crawl.ts http://localhost:4000`.
